module: Base class of a graphics quality group. It loads a presets module (e.g. meshQuality, terrainQuality), keeps the current level and applies a level by writing each key to VariableRegistry; if a value changed, it calls the module's onApply hook. Used by graphic.lua, not by regular extensions.
notes: The module returns a factory function (qualityLevelsFilename, groupName, options) and not an extension table.
The auto-generated page says init(groupName) but the actual code is init(qualitiyLevelsFilename, groupName).
applyLevel with an unknown level applies an empty table (no change) but still stores the name as the current level.
getCurrentLevel ignores its levelString parameter and returns the current level's table (nil if unknown).

C.desc: Quality group. Instance fields: currentQualityLevel (string, "" at start), qualityLevels (copy of group.qualityLevels), name (string, 'unnamed_quality_group' by default), onApply (module function, nop otherwise).

init.desc: Constructor called by the factory: require(qualityLevelsFilename) then copies qualityLevels and gets onApply. Without a file name, the group is empty.

qualitiyLevelsFilename.desc: Name of the module to load (require path or extension name).

applyLevel.desc: Applies the named level (via apply) then stores it as the current level. Does nothing if levelString is nil.

getCurrentLevel.desc: Returns the preset table of the current level.

getCurrentLevelId.desc: Returns the name of the current level.

apply.desc: For each key/value pair of the preset, reads VariableRegistry.get(key), compares by tostring, then VariableRegistry.set(key, value). If at least one value changed, calls self:onApply().
